verdict: Leads are coming in efficiently; the pipeline needs to convert them now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 121 leads at $10.57 each — and in the most recent 7 days, your cost per lead dropped 17.78% even as spend pulled back, which is a genuine efficiency gain. The concern is volume: at roughly $25 per day in ad spend, the pace of new leads is too low to build meaningful pipeline. More critically, your CRM shows 93 opportunities created this period with zero appointments booked and zero won — leads are arriving but not converting, which points to an intake process gap rather than an ads problem. We are working with you on the intake side to close that gap, and conversion tracking is being repaired so next period's numbers will give us a cleaner read on the full lead-to-patient path.
